description: Sidewalk Snow Removal - Nov 2019 - Edmonton Insight Community is a dataset listed in City of Edmonton open data portal (data.edmonton.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Edmonton. This was the Sidewalk Snow Removal - Nov 2019 survey. The City of Edmonton is collecting information on barriers and motivators to removing snow and ice on sidewalks adjacent to residential private property. Coverage: Edmonton. The portal files it under the category Surveys. Its tags are snow ice maintenance, survey, insight, snow complaints, snow removal. The table has 82 columns. The portal shows 2021-01-18 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-edmonton-ca-portal.
